subject: Share Web Tool in a Windows Server

messages.author: ce197138d7df0ae3
messages.subject: Share Web Tool in a Windows Server
parts: I'm trying to use a Windows server to host a web tool created by UI.R and server.R, and share it with the public. There are plenty of information on how to so in ShinyApps.io.  I can't find enough information on how to do so in a Windows server.  Can someone points me to the information.  Thanks!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Share Web Tool in a Windows Server
parts: Unfortunately we don't yet have a shiny server that runs on windows.  We have had some customers run a virtual machine on a windows box with Linux on it and use shiny server on the linux box.

messages.subject: Re: Share Web Tool in a Windows Server
parts: In Lesson 7 of Tutorial, there is one sentence said regarding what I tried to do: 'If you are familiar with web hosting or have access to an IT department, you can host your Shiny apps yourself.'  That makes me to believe that if I have a server that is always on 24/7, I can create a link for others to use the tool thru this server.  I just don't know enough how.  Thanks for your advice!
